# TerraScale docs — llms.txt (P-8)

> TerraScale is a multi-region document database: pay for writes and storage;
> reads, egress, fan-out, and subscribers are free. SQL is the only query
> language (D-78). Live queries and collection sync over CDN-backed HTTP
> long-polling by default. This file lists the docs routes for LLM consumers.

- https://docs.terrascale.tech/: TerraScale docs home: what TerraScale is, 5-minute quickstart.
- https://docs.terrascale.tech/getting-started: Quickstart: create-terrascale-app to first live query in < 5 minutes; runnable snippets.
- https://docs.terrascale.tech/concepts: Core concepts: documents, SQL-only queries (D-78), live queries vs collection sync (D-38), branches, tenants, placement.
- https://docs.terrascale.tech/pricing: Pricing (L-1 draft, generated from D-16/D-17/D-21/D-25/D-64): writes + storage billed, everything else free.
- https://docs.terrascale.tech/limits: Limits and unbilled abuse guards (D-25/D-64), generated from the same source as pricing.
- https://docs.terrascale.tech/snippets: Runnable snippets: every snippet runs against a real sandbox branch pre-filled with the reader's key (D-56).
- https://docs.terrascale.tech/blog/why-sqlite: Launch post stub (L-5): Why TerraScale runs on SQLite.
- https://docs.terrascale.tech/blog/reads-are-free: Launch post stub (L-5): Reads are free — how.
- https://docs.terrascale.tech/blog/benchmarks: Launch post stub (L-5): benchmarks.
- https://docs.terrascale.tech/blog/replication: Launch post stub (L-5): replication design.
- https://docs.terrascale.tech/blog/database-per-customer: Launch post stub (L-5): a database per customer.

## Pricing summary (L-1 draft; full tables in /pricing)

- Billed: writes (1 op <= 4 KiB; +1 per extra replicated region) and storage
  (logical bytes x regions at $/GB-month). Overage/PAYG: $1 per 1M writes,
  $0.20 per GB-month per region.
- Free/unbilled: reads, queries, egress, CDN delivery, fan-out, subscribers,
  WebSocket connections, webhooks, catch-up/replay, TTL expiry.
- A write is billed once regardless of views/subscribers (D-22).

## Snippet harness

- Snippet sources: docs/snippets/*.ts. Each exports `run(sandbox)`.
- Stub mode (CI, no credentials): `npm test`.
- Remote mode (real sandbox branch): TERRASCALE_SANDBOX_URL + TERRASCALE_API_KEY,
  `npm test -- --sandbox=remote`.
